description.zh: 需查询的Group ID列表的实例的ID。
description.en: The ID of the instance for which you want to list group IDs.

title.zh: 查看某实例下的所有 Group ID

descriptions.zh: 每成功调用一次**ListGroupId**接口，都会计算为一次消息TPS，从而影响您的计费。计费详情，请参见[计费说明](~~52819~~)。
descriptions.en: Each successful call to the **ListGroupId** operation is counted as one message transaction and is billed based on transactions per second (TPS). For more information, see [billing details](~~52819~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun onsmqtt list-group-id --instance-id mqtt-cn-0pp1ldu0000 --tag Value=test Key=test --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun onsmqtt ListGroupId --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key test --InstanceId 'mqtt-cn-0pp1ldu0000' --Tag.1.Value test
